## Description

Verify and fix registration, calendar, board, queue and settings at 768–1024 px (landscape and portrait): icon rail navigation, 44 px targets, board horizontal scroll, booking panel as a drawer.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Playwright visual checks at 768×1024 and 1024×768 pass for every P1 screen without clipped controls.
- [ ] **AC2.** All touch targets ≥ 44 px (automated check).
- [ ] **AC3.** Registration and check-in journeys complete on a tablet emulation end-to-end.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
